上游原文：For blank/from-scratch scenarios don't hand-assemble pages element by element with add_text_box/add_shape/add_smartart (crude layout). Use the generation pipeline instead: new whole deck → generate_deck; new pages for an existing deck → generate_deck(pages, insert_mode:"append"). Write it beautifully in HTML/CSS and the system converts it into editable elements. Use native tools only when the deck already has polished content and one element needs refining.
